Cache is keyed by prompt+branch+headSha (hooks/lib/prism-opus-classifier.mjs cacheKey()), NOT session_id, so a true cache hit is verified out-of-band by grepping ~/.claude/.prism-routing.jsonl for both calls' prompt_tier_router 'source' field, not by stdout text (formatAdvice() never echoes the word 'cache').

Pass criterion for the CACHE claim specifically: post-run grep .prism-routing.jsonl prompt_tier_router events for this session_id and diff the 'source' field between call 1 and call 2 (expect keyword-floor then cache). Runner's own stdout-substring check only proves tier=haiku on both calls, not cache-sourcing — documented as a scorer limitation, not a hook defect.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #12a: dispatch #1 in hard mode -> deny
scenarios.notes: UAT60 #12 leg 1/2 — REQUIRES env PRISM_MODEL_GUARD=hard for the whole run (not expressible in setup_sentinel; run this category as its own runner invocation with that env var set). sentinel.dispatched=false -> first dispatch of the turn -> MODE=hard + tier=opus -> shouldDeny=true. Hook's own done() always returns exit 0 even on deny (deny signalled via hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision='deny' JSON in stdout, NOT via process exit code) -- expected_exit_code is correctly 0, not 2.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #12b: dispatch #2 in hard mode -> advisory-only (turn-aware)

Score by diffing the two results' actual stdout field, not by the trivial empty-pattern pass alone.

scenarios.notes: UAT60 #20 leg 1/2 — SHAPE-UNCERTAIN per the plan; read hooks/prism-live-work-dedup.mjs source first (done). Real shape: PreToolUse:Agent with tool_input.subagent_type + prompt/description; the guard compares a FRESH dispatch's keywords against the ACCUMULATED task summaries of other LIVE agents (recorded via appendTaskSummary on every prior Agent dispatch or scope-assigning SendMessage), keyed by subagent_type as agent id. scenarios.name: UAT60 #22: turn-20+ strong /clear recommendation

Counter increments to 20 -> second nudge (turn 20, next nudge at 25) -- text is the SAME template as turn 15 with only the turn numbers differing; that numeric delta is the actual 'escalation' signal this hook produces (no separately-worded strong variant exists in source).

scenarios.name: UAT60 #23: Stop hook session summary write

Requires a real, minimal, valid JSONL transcript file at transcript_path (placeholder above substituted with the actual scratchpad path at run time). Pass verified out-of-band: check ~/.claude/.prism-sessions/audit-UAT60-F23.md exists post-run, not just exit code (hook never writes to stdout).

scenarios.notes: UAT60 #34 — SHAPE-UNCERTAIN per the plan; read hooks/prism-capture-evidence-guard.mjs source first (done). CORRECTION vs the plan's guess: this hook does NOT validate deviation-report header/Rule-line SHAPE at all -- it only checks (a) file path in-scope (docs/prism/adjudications|lessons|deviations, tasks/lessons-*.md) and (b) a verification-style claim ('confirms') with no **Verified:** field anywhere in the resulting content. The real, verifiable FIX-4b contract is scope inclusion of docs/prism/deviations/ -- this payload asserts a claim with no Verified field under a deviations/ path and must deny, proving deviations/ is in-scope post-FIX-4b.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #35: FIX-4c ratchet — new unverified claim alongside carried Verified line

## Entry A

**Verified:** ran tests, all green.
tool_input.new_string:
## Entry A

**Verified:** ran tests, all green.

## Entry B

This confirms the bug is fixed.

scenarios.notes: UAT60 #35 — file does not exist on disk, so resultingContent() for Edit returns new_string verbatim as 'whole file' (fallback branch); addedRegion(old_string,new_string) line-diffs to isolate the truly-new '## Entry B / This confirms the bug is fixed.' text, which carries a NEW heading + a claim ('confirms'/'is fixed') + NO Verified field of its own -> ratchet violation -> deny, even though the whole content contains a historical Verified line. Confirm via routing-log grep for {event:'capture_evidence_guard', ratchet:'per-entry'} on this session_id.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #39: FIX-6 superpowers retirement stance on brainstorm prompt

input_payload.prompt: help me brainstorm a new feature before implementing it

scenarios.notes: UAT60 #39 — read skills/prism-plan/references/skill-triggers.md (the curated map this hook consumes) first: it contains NO row for 'brainstorm' or for the superpowers plugin at all (12 curated rows, all pointing at PRISM-native or other installed skills). So this prompt matches ZERO triggers and the hook is silent by construction -- the FIX-6 'does not blindly recommend superpowers' stance is satisfied trivially because superpowers was never added as a trigger target, not because of runtime retirement logic. Score PASS with this caveat documented, not as evidence of an active retirement mechanism firing.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #52: PreCompact nudge flag write

Verify the flag file's mtime/content post-run, not stdout.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #53: SessionEnd dispatcher fan-out completes cleanly
scenarios.notes: UAT60 #53 — LIMITATION discovered by reading source: prism-sessionend-dispatcher.mjs calls each sub-hook's run() but discards its return value entirely (Promise.all(...).catch(()=>{})) and unconditionally process.exit(0)s regardless of any sub-hook's internal outcome. This scenario can only prove 'the dispatcher itself does not throw/hang', NOT that each of the 3 fanned-out hooks (clean-nudge, git-clean-nudge, acl-sessionend) individually succeeded -- that would require invoking each sub-hook directly and separately, which the plan's #53 did not request. Documented honestly rather than overclaiming per-hook coverage.

scenarios.name: UAT60 #54: handoff-pointer write on SESSION-HANDOFF.md Write
scenarios.notes: UAT60 #54 — cwd is DELIBERATELY overridden to a scratch directory, NOT left to default to process.cwd() / this repo -- prism-handoff-pointer.mjs writes <cwd>/.claude/.prism-latest-handoff.json as a real side effect, and running it with the default cwd would overwrite THIS repo's real, live latest-handoff pointer used by prism-session-start.mjs's HANDOFF-RECALL. The `{{TMP}}` token is a portable placeholder substituted by prism-audit-runner.mjs (stdinPayload()) at run time for an OS-temp-rooted scratch dir (node:os tmpdir()), so no machine-specific absolute path is baked into the scenario. The scratch cwd keeps the mutation isolated. Verify <scratch>/.claude/.prism-latest-handoff.json content post-run.
